en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 stays; Saudel 330 km east at 3pm
en.dek: Tropical Storm Saudel was centred about 330 kilometres east of Hong Kong at 3pm and is forecast to move northeast at about 10 km/h across the northeastern South China Sea.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Standby Signal No. 1 remained in force on Wednesday afternoon. At 3pm, Tropical Storm Saudel was estimated to be about 330 kilometres east of Hong Kong near 22.2 degrees north, 117.4 degrees east.

The storm is forecast to move northeast at about 10 kilometres per hour across the northeastern part of the South China Sea. Under the combined influence of Saudel and the northeast monsoon, winds are occasionally strong offshore and on high ground.

The Observatory said the signal is expected to remain in force for the rest of Wednesday. According to the present forecast, Saudel will linger over the northeastern South China Sea tonight and into Thursday before having a higher chance of turning westwards, skirting the coast of eastern Guangdong and edging closer to the Pearl River Estuary around Friday to Saturday. There remain rather large uncertainties in its intensity by then.

The Observatory will closely monitor Saudel’s movement and assess whether the Strong Wind Signal No. 3 is required as the system nears the estuary. Members of the public are advised to stay alert to the latest weather information.

zh.headline: 一號戒備信號維持 沙德爾下午3時位於本港以東約330公里
zh.dek: 熱帶風暴沙德爾下午3時位於本港以東約330公里，預料向東北移動，時速約10公里，橫過南海東北部。
body: 香港天文台表示，一號戒備信號周三下午繼續生效。下午3時，熱帶風暴沙德爾集結在香港以東約330公里，即北緯22.2度、東經117.4度附近。
預料沙德爾向東北移動，時速約10公里，橫過南海東北部。受沙德爾與東北季候風共同影響，本港離岸及高地間中吹強風。
天文台指，一號戒備信號預料在今日餘下時間維持。按照現時預測，沙德爾今晚至明日初時會在南海東北部徘徊，其後有較大機會轉向偏西方向移動，掠過廣東東部沿岸，並在星期五至星期六左右再度靠近珠江口一帶，屆時其強度存在相當大變數。
天文台會密切監察沙德爾的動向，評估其接近珠江口時是否需要改發三號強風信號。市民請繼續留意天文台的最新天氣消息。
